mutations.name: the config accepts seat-waives before its resolver path exists
kills: loadConfig reads the non-source NO_REPRO key, and rejects seat-waives until its resolver path exists

mutations.name: a misspelt visual threshold key is stripped instead of refused
kills: loadConfig keeps each repo's visual threshold, and refuses a misspelt key, a share above 1 or a repo that is not owner/name

mutations.name: the visual threshold refuses mode on, so nothing can decide on it
kills: loadConfig keeps a visual threshold mode of on, refuses an unknown mode, and caps the measuring work config can ask for

mutations.name: the visual threshold's maxBytes has no ceiling
kills: loadConfig keeps a visual threshold mode of on, refuses an unknown mode, and caps the measuring work config can ask for
